inland.licence: National fishing fee (fiskeravgift, Miljødirektoratet) only for anadromous salmon, sea trout and sea char in rivers and lakes; under-18s exempt.
inland.permit: Local fiskekort from the fishing rights holder, for all freshwater fishing. Online for many waters (inatur.no) or at local shops and tourist offices.

sea.reporting: Registered fishing camps report guests' catches daily; no individual reporting app (Norway is not in the EU).

inland.licence: Karta wędkarska issued by the starosta (county office) after the exam held by an angling association such as PZW; fee 10 zł. Required by the Inland Fisheries Act, Art. 7. Exempt: children under 14 fishing with an adult card holder, and foreigners staying temporarily in Poland. PZW membership is not a legal requirement; it is only needed for PZW waters.
inland.permit: Zezwolenie from the rights holder of the fishing district (obwód rybacki). Wody Polskie (RZGW) districts: electronic only since January 2026, bought via the Wirtualny Informator Rzeczny (wir.wody.gov.pl or the WIR app); you get a PDF with a QR code. PZW districts (okręgi) sell their own annual and short-term permits, each with its own rules. Permits often require a catch register (rejestr połowu); e.g. Wody Polskie Lublin wants it returned by 31 Jan.
inland.visitors: No karta wędkarska needed for foreigners staying temporarily, but the water permit (Wody Polskie via WIR, or PZW/other rights holder) is required.
inland.bans: No fishing in protective zones (obręby ochronne, signed with blue/yellow boards or buoys). These can cover fish passes and at least 50 m above and below them, spawning, wintering and migration sites. PZW district rules (e.g. Siedlce 2026, Katowice) ban fishing within 50 m of weirs, locks, dams and other damming structures; groynes and bed sills are exempt. Local permit rules apply.
inland.boat: Set by each permit. Example, Wody Polskie Lublin 2026: two rods for float or ledger fishing, or one rod for spinning or fly; trolling banned on all waters; keep 25 m from other anglers; boat fishing from 30 Apr to 15 Dec, at night only 1 Jun-15 Sep; no boats on ice-covered water. Other districts allow trolling only on waters named in the permit. Check the permit for each water.

sea.licence: Fee-based right from GIRM (Główny Inspektorat Rybołówstwa Morskiego): proof of payment, no paper permit. 15 zł/week, 25 zł/month, 65 zł/12 months (50 zł with Karta Dużej Rodziny). Pay by bank transfer to the GIRM account (NBP O/Gdańsk 60 1010 1140 0003 5822 3100 0000) with title 'za wykonywanie rybołówstwa rekreacyjnego na okres ...' and your name. Carry ID plus proof of payment. Fishing from a boat on open Baltic waters, the EEZ, territorial sea, Puck Bay or the Gulf of Gdańsk: e-mail polowy.rekreacyjne@girm.gov.pl at least 2 h before you start (vessel name, start date/time, area or port).
sea.visitors: Same as residents: pay the GIRM fee and carry ID. No karta wędkarska is needed at sea.
sea.reporting: EU RecFishing app (Poland is a RecFishing country; EU Login or Profil Zaufany), per Reg. 2023/2842 Art. 55, since 10 Jan 2026. National rule as well: after fishing from a boat, if you caught cod, sprat, herring or eel, file a catch report before entering port and deliver it to GIRM by the next day (by e-mail, by post or at a GIRM office).
sea.bans: Not from navigation marks or bridges. Keep at least 100 m from areas closed to commercial fishing and from bathing areas. Boats: not in fairways or anchorages; keep 100 m from set fishing gear and from charted wrecks. Do not moor to navigation marks, fishing gear or buoys. No rod fishing in the ports of Darłowo, Dźwirzyno, Kołobrzeg, Łeba, Mrzeżyno, Rowy and Ustka from 15 Sep to end of Feb between 17:00 and 07:00; spinning and multi-hook rigs are also banned there in that period. Kołobrzeg Parsęta section closed 1 Sep-31 Dec.
sea.boat: Max 2 rods per person, or 1 rod for spinning/fly. Trolling (holowanie przynęt, no live fish) is allowed outside port waters: max 1 rod per angler in internal waters and lagoons, max 12 rods per boat on the open sea, territorial sea and EEZ. Keep 50 m between boats, 150 m when spinning. Retained fish must be landed whole; each angler keeps their own catch separate.
